reason: Three free months and it sits next to my terminal, so I lose nothing by putting QR codes on the tables and watching what happens. Knowing who my regulars are and getting reviews only from people who actually paid is worth a try.
objection: My older regulars hand me cash or a card and chat at the counter. I doubt many will scan a QR to pay, and if only a handful do, the visit data and reviews are thin and 59 GEL plus the partner's fee on top is hard to justify.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free months fewer than about a quarter of my guests pay by QR, or the partner's per-transaction fee is higher than what my bank terminal charges, I cancel.
